slides.title: Introduction: Next-Gen Web Presentations
slides.notes: Welcome attendees. Today we are demonstrating live interactive slides, WYSIWYG element editing, and drag-and-drop repositioning.

slides.title: Core Platform Capabilities

slides.title: Modular System Architecture
slides.notes: Explain how the renderer isolates slides inside sandboxed iframes while maintaining high-performance IPC with the main process.

slides.title: Performance & Live Metrics
slides.notes: Click through the quarter filters (Q1-Q4) to showcase live SVG/CSS bar chart data re-rendering in real time.

slides.title: Interactive Canvas Dynamics
slides.notes: Move and drag the cursor across the canvas to show off 60 FPS hardware-accelerated particle dynamics.
